title: What if light walked for 5 seconds?

scenes.notes: Frame 1 = cover. Busy night crossing: cars streaming in the near and far lanes, crowd walking, screens scrolling, red signal wait bar, tourist raises phone at 3.0, full Moon rising. Title clears by 4.5. [screen 0.0-4.5 s; bubble R 0.00-0.00 m]

layers.text: You're at Shibuya Crossing, waiting on red.

scenes.notes: Friend turns and starts to wave at 6.0 (armR track); arm halfway at 7.0. [screen 4.5-7.0 s; bubble R 0.00-0.00 m]

layers.text: The whole city just went black.

scenes.notes: World to a 6% ghost; only a sphere of light around your head (R 0 -> 0.48 m). City sound carries on. Shutter click at 10.3 from the dark right (ripple glyph), nothing lit. Shake is internal to CrossingSet. [screen 7.0-10.8 s; bubble R 0.00-0.48 m]

layers.text: Even your own hand is dark, until...

scenes.notes: Light edge crawls from elbow (lit 9.4) to fingertips (lit 12.5). Dotted felt hand wiggles from 13.0; the seen hand stays frozen. [screen 10.8-15.8 s; bubble R 0.48-1.12 m]
The seen hand starts following at 18.5 (0.5 event s behind the felt one). [screen 15.8-19.5 s; bubble R 1.12-1.59 m]

layers.text: Sound now travels faster than light.

scenes.notes: Bubble R 1.59 -> 2.29 m; ground lights from 19.6; ring tag. Sound ripples from the dark (ding = crossing-chime stand-in). [screen 19.5-25.0 s; bubble R 1.59-2.29 m]

scenes.notes: TEXTLESS. The lit road in front of you is empty; the car passes 1.0 m away at 26.5 (sound + wind only: jacket/hair whip, paper cup tumbles). Horn: synthesize car_horn on the Spark (stinger stand-in). [screen 25.0-30.6 s; bubble R 2.29-3.00 m]

layers.text: Your friend lights up, still mid-wave.

scenes.notes: Bubble edge reaches the friend (3.0 m) at 30.57: she lights up frozen mid-wave, then waves slowly, 2.14 s late. [screen 30.6-34.3 s; bubble R 3.00-3.47 m]

layers.text: Then the car appears, driving backwards.

scenes.notes: Car image appears at 34.32 a metre in front of you and splits (heroCar.imageReversing / imageForward, metres from the closest point). Tourist (4.0 m) lights up at 38.43 with the phone raised. [screen 34.3-41.7 s; bubble R 3.47-4.42 m]
The flash fired at 10.3 reaches your eyes at 41.73: full white 1.0 s (rect, z under the HUD; HUD inverts 41.7-42.9), fades to the crossing. [screen 41.7-44.0 s; bubble R 4.42-4.71 m]

layers.text: Every phone signal is stuck mid-air.

scenes.notes: The tourist's phone (inside your bubble, so lit): no bars, spinner. No on-screen words. [screen 44.0-47.0 s; bubble R 4.71-5.09 m]
Black sky, ghost full Moon over ghost towers, ghost stars, two satellite dots. HUD climbs MOON -> SUN -> STAR (log ladder). No captions. [screen 47.0-54.0 s; bubble R 5.09-5.98 m]

layers.text: But every lamp keeps pouring out light.

scenes.notes: Bubble ~6.0 m. MEANWHILE inset: a neon sign in the dark with a thick growing halo of trapped light. HUD LIGHT PILED UP live. [screen 54.0-57.5 s; bubble R 5.98-6.43 m]
Bubble 6.2 -> 7.0 m, edge leaves the frame by 61; HUD clock under 0:00.100 at 61.0. [screen 57.5-62.0 s; bubble R 6.43-7.00 m]

exposure.perObjectWindow: min(5, r/1.4) inside the bubble, 5 s outside

layers.text: Light is back. All five seconds of it.

scenes.notes: Return: white flash 62.0-62.4 (rect), then the long-exposure afterimage (cars as streaks, crowd smears, signal red AND green, friend arm fan of 5, the car double) over the normal crossing. [screen 62.0-65.5 s; bubble R 7.00-7.00 m]

exposure.perObjectWindow: min(5, r/1.4) inside the bubble, 5 s outside

layers.text: Everything you missed hits your eyes at once.

scenes.notes: Afterimage fades. Caption 11. [screen 65.5-68.0 s; bubble R 7.00-7.00 m]
Frame-1 framing, normal light; signal green, crowd surging, friend waving. HUD fades out 68.0-68.5. No text. [screen 68.0-69.5 s; bubble R 7.00-7.00 m]
Black, music out. [screen 69.5-70.5 s; bubble R 7.00-7.00 m]

layers.text: HARVARD, 2001 · LENE HAU'S LAB STOPPED A PULSE OF LIGHT IN ULTRACOLD ATOMS, THEN LET IT GO.

scenes.notes: End card: exact title repeat + fact (neither is read). [screen 70.5-78.0 s; bubble R 7.00-7.00 m]
